directions: From the Village of Daajing Giids, travel 22.5km on the Queen Charlotte Mainline to the Rennell Sound FSR. Travel 16km on the Rennell Sound FSR to the dry land sort. Drive approximately 250m up the Bonanza FSR to the trail head.
